# Hibiscus 0.8.32

Fast1 reduces repeated work in large note libraries and makes optional AI
processing after import easier to control.

- The sidebar reuses its note ordering and groups while you write or receive
  an AI reply, instead of rebuilding them for content-only changes.
- AI processing after import now runs at most two actions at once. Track
  progress, pause, cancel, or retry failed actions in Settings. Actions on the
  same note run in order, and cancelling AI processing keeps your imported notes.
- Clicking an empty part of the Assistant input now sends the very first
  character to the message input, without changing the open note.
- Saving a new API key or changing a custom endpoint prevents an older
  validation response from overwriting the new connection state.
- API keys saved through the local Keychain fallback are no longer removed
  by synchronization cleanup. A local fallback is reported as local storage.
- Note search uses the same workspace scope as the sidebar, including the
  default workspace during startup.
- The sidebar can display a library containing duplicate note identifiers
  without crashing. Existing note records are not deleted or merged.

No note migration or API-key re-entry is required.
